about: The Workbench icons of the Amoebax drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/amoebax.png is upstream's own icon (data/amoebax.png, Free Art License, like the rest of Amoebax's art). Amoebax-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, put beside the drawer as Amoebax.info; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Amoebax.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the data and User drawers' icon.
